fusions.name: Tenderiser
fusions.desc: Pounds the target for 4 damage and leaves it 6% easier to wound for 5 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Dinner Gong
fusions.desc: Strikes a gong that deals 28 resonating damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 25% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Trestle Table
fusions.desc: Knocks together a laden table where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Cracked for Marrow
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your attacks heal you for 20% of the damage they deal for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
